categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Modifies connection manager logic in src/net.cpp and src/net.h to deduplicate -addnode peers.
categories.rationale: Deduplicating `-addnode` startup arguments eliminates redundant DNS lookups and connection attempts for duplicated peers. The problem is minor and only triggered by repeated configuration values, but aligning startup argument handling with runtime `addnode add` RPC checks provides clear value.
